policy: Explained divergences between the official runner's wire-schema-valid check (and its wire-schema-harness-error twin) and mcp-trace-validator's report wire_schema member, message by message, over the sessions the runner drove (docs/plan/03-conformance-strategy.md §Calibration; ADR-0020). Messages are joined by sender and canonical JSON. Each entry requires: leg (server | client | draft-2025-11-25 | draft-2026-07-28), kind (validator-only: we flag a message the runner passed; suite-only: the runner flags a message we passed, or one no tapped session carries), message_contains (substring of the canonical message, required), class (our-bug | suite-bug | spec-ambiguity | schema-pin-skew: the runner's bundled schema copy and our vendored one at wire_schema::UPSTREAM_COMMIT differ), upstream (issue/PR/commit URL) and reason; optionally origin (implementation | harness) and trace_contains. Unknown fields are rejected. The gate (cargo xtask conformance, cargo xtask draft-readiness) fails on any divergence not listed here and on any entry for a compared leg that explains nothing; remove an entry in the change that resolves it.
